title: Wake delivery is a cross client contract
summary: The observed failure surfaced in Codex Desktop, but the invariant is cross-client: any harness using lib/schedule-wakeup.js can successfully fire a .fire event while still failing to deliver the prompt unless a durable client-specific or daemon-owned delivery path is active. Claude has a native ScheduleWakeup path, so it is a different case. Cursor and OpenCode use the shared scheduler substrate for armed wakeups and should be audited/hardened with the same delivery-owner/status contract rather than treating Codex as unique.
